items.statement: Management decided against a share swap for the acquisition because they believe Datamatics is not fairly valued in the market and a swap would mean selling cheap.
items.quote: So, we still believe that Datamatics is not fairly valued in the market. So, if we did a swap, we believe we'll be selling cheap.

items.statement: Generated operating cash flow of INR122 crores in FY23 and repaid INR75 crores of borrowings in first six months of FY24
items.quote: We believe in financial discipline and the company has judicially utilized cash towards lowering debt from INR 107 crores in March '23 to INR 26 crores as of September '23 and generated cash flow from operation of INR122 crores in FY'23 which allow us to reinvest this in new market and products.

items.statement: MD and CEO Chandra Shekhar Ghosh holds half percent stake in the bank; family stake at holding company level is less than two percent
items.quote: As an MD, I have a stake in the bank. It is so because I was a Founder. I have some initial capital that I needed to give to the bank to start it. That is only half percent. But the holding company level, we have the holding at the family level, the stake is less than two percent.

items.statement: Audit is ongoing and will take another month to conclude; no findings received from auditor or NCGTC; retirement has no linkage to audit
items.quote: the audit is still going on and it is going to take another one month or so to get concluded. We haven't heard anything from the auditor or from NCGTC in this regard. Therefore, it has absolutely no linkage with the audit.

items.statement: Company generated positive cash from operations of INR 3,992 million at end of FY23
items.quote: The company is generating positive cash from operations to a tune of INR3,992 million as at the end of FY23.

items.statement: Company raised Rs.120 crore via preferential issue of 1 crore shares in October 2023 for medium-term capital support.
items.quote: In October 2023, the company successfully raised Rs.120 crore by the way of preferential issue (issuing 1 crore shares) on a private placement basis. This infusion provided medium term capital support to ensure smooth operations.

items.statement: Board approved fundraise of about Rs.500 crore through QIP or preferential issue for inorganic growth, capacity expansion and backward integration.
items.quote: Sir, the last question from my side is on the fundraise which the board has approved through QIP or PREF. Sir, how do we intend to use these proceeds of about Rs.500 crores which the board has approved?

items.statement: QIP of Rs.500 crore expected to be completed by end of first quarter.
items.quote: Pinkesh, by end of first quarter it should be completed.

items.statement: Average monthly collection from customers during H2FY24 was Rs.144 crore indicating stringent internal controls.
items.quote: Average monthly collection from customers during H2FY24 was Rs.144 crore which indicates stringent internal controls systems in place.

items.statement: Majority of outstanding from GETCO received and rest coming as expected; GETCO not an issue.
items.quote: Ashwani, we have received majority of the outstanding from the GETCO and the rest of the money is coming as expected. So GETCO is not an issue to us.

items.statement: Deliberately quoting less to State Electricity Boards and more to EPC contractors to improve cash flows.
items.quote: We have deliberately taken a decision that we would be quoting less to State Electricity Board and more to EPC contractors who are in eventual ly servicing the State Electricity Board. That helps our cash flows better

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved drastically; creditors and debtors down; short-term and long-term borrowings down drastically.
items.quote: if you see on my present presentation and balance sheet, my working capital cycle has been improved drasticallyand we are actually further strengthening that. If you see on my creditors' side, my creditors have gone down drastically as well as my debtors are going down

items.statement: Currently collecting more than Rs.125 crore to Rs.130 crore every month strengthening working capital cycle.
items.quote: And if you heard my speech that now every month, we are collecting more than Rs.125 crores to Rs.130 crores, that itself is strengthening my working capital cycle.

items.statement: Target working capital cycle of 120 days; retail strategy in place to achieve it.
items.quote: There is a retail strategy in place for that, and we are working on that direction piece.

name: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Limited

items.statement: Current cash balance around $20 million plus approved credit gives 12-15 months runway factoring cost savings from Vodobatinib deprioritization
items.quote: If I look at our current cash balance which should be in the range of around $20 million and we also have access to approved credit, and if I actually look at both approved credit and the current available cash, we should be able to basically go beyond the current financial year.

items.statement: Metro Cast acquisition stake increased to 50.1% in Q4 FY24, consolidation started from Q2 FY24 at 34% stake
items.quote: This quarter we have as per the agreement and all we have increased our stake to 50.1% now in the Company.

items.statement: Metro Cast added 4.5 lakh subscribers to consolidated base of 9.5 million
items.quote: Yes, it's like 4.4 to 4.5 lakhs which is there in 9.5 million which we have given. So, 4.5 lakh subscriber has come from the Metro Cast.

items.statement: Operating cash flow impacted by project working capital, margin money and OD utilization for BharatNet project
items.quote: Yes. So, you will see that there is an increase in borrowing. This is mainly due to the project we have to give some margin money and we hav e to utilize our limits, the OD limits fully and because of that you will see there is an increase in the borrowing right now

items.statement: Trade receivables and payables both increased ~80% from broadcaster pay-channel transactions
items.quote: Yes it's trade receivable is both the trade receivables and payable is almost both side around 80% is the increase that is 80% is from the pay channel from the broadcasts.

items.statement: No fresh equity issuance mentioned; Metro Cast acquisition funded via cash and STB boxes recorded as investment not CAPEX
items.quote: No, whatever we did that is coming under the investment in our books right now and from next year onwards we are going to go for the CAPEX and all because the deal as you can see there that was to give him the cheque or cash for 25 crore plus the boxes of 2.30 lakh that's why. So, those all have gone into the investment right now.

items.statement: Board approved buyback of 3.7 lakh equity shares at Rs. 4,450 per share for aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 164.65 crores representing 0.88% of total paid-up equity share capital
items.value: 3.7 lakh shares at Rs. 4,450 per share, Rs. 164.65 crores aggregate, 0.88% of paid-up capital
items.quote: In addition to the dividend, the Board has also approved the proposal to buy back 3.7 lakh equity shares of the company at Rs. 4,450 per share for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 164.65 crores that represents 0.88% of the total paid up equity share capital.

items.statement: FY24 collections grew about 17.7% year-on-year.
items.quote: Our FY'24 collections have grown by about 17.7% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Cash and investments stood at INR4,625 crores at quarter end, growing 13.7% year-on-year.
items.quote: Overall, cash and investments stood at INR4,625 crores as on quarter end, growing about 13.7% year-on-year.

items.statement: Cash balance of INR4,625 crores is yielding 7.2% pre-tax with no concrete decision on deployment or distribution.
items.quote: So Lavanya, the cash balance of INR4,625 crores, so righ t now, and is yielding 7.2% pre -tax for us. And at this point of time, there is no concrete decision on either deployment or distribution of this

items.statement: Completed a capital raise of Rs.15 billion via QIP for margin monies and MTF book growth
items.quote: In this spirit, we recently completed a capital raise of Rs.15 billion which will be primarily used for margin monies with stock exchange and t he growth of our MTF book

name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd

items.statement: Advances received for projects increased to almost INR900 crores, driving the rise in other current liabilities
items.quote: The increase in other current liabilities is essentially because of advances received for projects to the tune of almost INR900 crores.

items.statement: CFO Vinit Teredesai is stepping down and Vipul Chandra is appointed as new CFO designate
items.quote: I'm pleased to welcome Vipul Chandra as our new Chief Financial Officer. His extensive experience will be invaluable in steering our financial strategy towards continued success. I also want to extend my deepest gratitude to Vinit Teredesai for his outstanding contributions during his tenure.

items.statement: Operating cash flow to PAT improved to 123.7% for FY24 from 70.2% in FY23
items.quote: Cash generation for the year improved significantly in FY24, with the Operating Cash Flow-to-PAT at 123.7%, compared to 70.2% in FY23.

items.statement: Free cash flow to PAT improved to 105.5% for FY24 from 49% in FY23
items.quote: Free-Cash-Flow-to-PAT came in at 105.5% compared to 49% last year.

items.statement: Billed DSO reduced to 57 days in Q4 from 62 days in Q3
items.quote: Our billed DSO further reduced to 57 days, versus 62 days in Q3.

items.statement: Total DSO including unbilled reduced by 11 days during FY24 to 80 days in Q4
items.quote: We have made significant progress and have brought down the total DSO by 11 days during FY24. In Q4, the total receivable days, including unbilled DSO, was 80 days, an improvement of 5 days sequentially.

items.statement: Cash and investment balance reached all-time high of USD 1.38 billion or INR 11,525 crores
items.quote: We closed the year with an all-time high cash and investment balance that stood at USD 1.38 billion or ₹11,525 crores compared to ₹10,116 crores in Q3 FY24.

items.statement: Q4 operating cash flow to PAT was 158.4% versus 155.7% in Q3
items.quote: The Operating Cash Flow-to-PAT was 158.4% as against 155.7% in the previous quarter, and 88.5% in the same quarter a year ago.

items.statement: Q4 free cash flow to PAT was 131.5% versus 143.7% in Q3
items.quote: Free-Cash-Flow-to-PAT conversion held its strong trend and came in at 131.5% compared to 143.7% last quarter, and 77.7% in the same quarter a year ago.

items.statement: Trade receivables at Rs 1,458 crore with Rs 650 crore collected in Q4 FY24
items.quote: Our trade receivables stand at around Rs. 1,458 crores at the end of the year. This is partly also linked to the revenues that we have done during the quarter. We had collection over Rs. 650 crores this quarter.

items.statement: Cash position at Rs 641 crore and working capital borrowings at Rs 1,744 crore at end of FY24
items.quote: Our cash position at the end of the year was Rs. 641 crores and working capital borrowings of Rs. 1,744 crores, which is essentially all for working capital.

items.statement: Inventory increased to Rs 3,738 crore from Rs 2,683 crore previous quarter for BSNL 4G project execution
items.quote: inventory of Rs. 3,738 crores increased compared to the previous quarter, which was around Rs. 2,683 crores. Predominantly because, as mentioned in the previous call as well, we are securing long-lead items for expedited delivery of large projects, including the BSNL 4G.

items.statement: Working capital increased by Rs 1,519 crore driven by inventory and receivables
items.quote: Working capital increased by 1,519 crores, again driven mainly by inventory and receivables.

items.statement: Mr. Bhave retired as independent director and Mr. Lakshmi narayanan resigned as non-executive non-independent director
items.quote: Mr. Bhave, who has been a director for many years, he retired as a non -executive independent director on the completion of his tenure and Mr. Lakshmi narayanan also resigned as a no-executive non-independent director to spend time for his professional commitments.

items.statement: Preferential debt from group company reduced from INR150 crores to INR95 crores; priority to repay it first.
items.quote: So, the preferential debt was INR150 crores as on last year, which has come down to INR95 crores.

items.statement: Working capital requirement increased by INR70-100 crores due to higher operations and new products.
items.quote: And working capital also, since we have increased our operations drastically, so our working capital requirement also has gone up compared to last year and this year in the range of around INR70 to INR100 crores.

items.statement: Revenue from Meghmani Organics is 10-11% of total revenue.
items.quote: I mean when I say 10% to 11% that will be of the total revenue.

items.statement: Liquid balance of close to Rs.280 crore as on March 31st with near nil borrowings
items.quote: With good efforts on inventory and debtors, we have close to Rs.280 crore of liquid balance as on March 31st, with near nil borrowings.

items.statement: Company completed QIP in January 2024 raising INR500 crores used to retire debt and for general corporate purposes
items.quote: The company in January this year completed its QIP, in which the company raised about exactly INR500 crores and tha t money was used basically to retire debt and the other purposes of the company, general corporate purposes of the company, which is all done

items.statement: FY24 overall cash flow inflow was INR1,260 crores with improved operational cash flow quarter-on-quarter
items.quote: In FY '24, collection yields as an impressive overall cash flow inflow in FY '24 is INR1,260 crores.

items.statement: Received INR3.27 crore subsidy installment in March 2024; five more annual installments expected
items.quote: INR3.27 crores. That was a capex we had done three years back to expand our capacity in Pithampur plant where we were sanctioned a total subsidy of INR22 -odd crores, which is to be paid to us in eight years' time. So out of eight years, we have received the third installment on 31st March. Shridhar Kallani: Okay. Sunil Chordia: So for next five years, we will get similar

items.statement: ECL provisions for non-Mahindra 3PL receivables are 0.3% to 0.4% on Rs 500-600 crore exposure
items.quote: At an overall level our ECL dock, our non-Mahindra supply chain, 3PL supply chain receivables level is between Rs 500 crores to Rs 600 crores and our ECL provisions around 0.3% to 0.4%.

items.statement: Board approved first interim dividend of Rs 3.5 per share for FY25
items.quote: Before we deep dive into financi als, we would like to highlight that the Board has approved the first interim dividend of Rs 3.5 per share for FY25

items.statement: RBI rejected three external candidates for MD & CEO; bank has restarted selection process with public advertisement
items.quote: What happened is they hav e said that they have not found suitable . So, the Bank has already again started the process. So, the committee is on. The nomination and remuneration committee of the board met and the process has been started. Even the public advertisement has been given calling for the applications

items.statement: Provision of Rs.84 crores made for possible salary increase; Rs.69 crores provided in FY24 and Rs.15 crores in prior year
items.quote: During Q4 alone, we have made a p rovision of 28 crores and totally today I have a provision towards the possible salary increase to the extent of around Rs.84 crores. Out of Rs.84 crores 69 crores is made during this year and 15 crores ever since I took charge, I have been making small p rovision, 15 crores was made in the last year and this year we had made 69 crores

items.statement: Q4 free cash flow was nearly INR129 crores, driven by collections and inventory reduction
items.quote: The net result of all of these actions meant that we generated a positive free cash flow of nearly INR129 crores, which is a significant achievement for us.

items.statement: Full year free cash flow was negative INR104 crores but manageable given 40%+ growth
items.quote: Our FCF for the full year is negative INR104 crores and even though this is negative, it is manageable and in cont rol given the 40% plus growth that we saw in the business

items.statement: Net working capital at 79 days in Q4, lowest in four quarters; target 90-100 days average for FY25
items.quote: If you see our net working capital, it is at 79 days, which is the lowest it has been in the past four quarters.

items.statement: DSO reduced to 57 days and inventory holding reduced by 20 days in Q4
items.quote: we were able to drive collections and reduce the overall -- overdue receivables to end the DS O 57 days. We were also able to reduce our inventory holding by 20 days in

items.statement: Customer advances at 25 days in Q4, down from previous levels
items.quote: we have reflected that at the end of Q4, we have 25 days of advances.

items.statement: No deviations in IPO proceeds usage; external debt cleared, INR80 crores used for working capital and some for capex
items.quote: Lastly, on the IPO proceeds utili zation, we have cleared the external debt and have used approximately INR80 crores for funding the working capital requirement that was used towards growth and a small amoun t towards capex

items.statement: IPO proceeds of ~INR300 crores earmarked for working capital; half to be used for working capital, rest for capex, M&A, general corporate
items.quote: we had about INR300 crores roughly earmarked towards the working capital requirement. Then we have certain other objects of the issue earmarked towards M&A and some for general corporate proceeds.

items.statement: Receivables collected in about 60 days, payables paid in about 60 days, working capital neutral for WhatsApp business
items.quote: On an average, you collect in about 60 odd days from invoicing, and you may pay in 60 odd days from invoicing. So, it it'll be more neutral, I would say.

items.statement: Enabling resolution of up to INR 700 crores for capital raise; QIP timing is open-ended, dependent on right investors and valuations
items.quote: Having said that, we have an enabling resolution to raise capital whenever we require. As I shared with you last time, we have an enabling resolution of upto INR 700 crores.

items.statement: QIP timing is absolutely open-ended; will meet investors quarter-on-quarter and decide based on valuations and alignment
items.quote: It is absolutely open-ended because this is an exercise done very well in advance, not from the statutory requirement or not even from the gearing point of view.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents plus unavailed limits totalled Rs 30.3 billion as of 31 March 2024.
items.quote: As of 31st March 2024, we maintained a sufficient liquidity of Rs. 30.3 billion in the form of cash and cash equivalent , and unavailed CC limit and documented unavailed sanction from various banks, including Rs. 2.3 billion from National Housing bank.

items.statement: ESOP pool is 2% of equity with 30-40% utilized; small P&L charge this year
items.quote: No, the total, overall budget is 2%. U tilization is not even 30%-40% till now
